<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Sentiment:</strong> Domestic indices retreated from recent highs, snapping a four-day winning streak, as traders balanced global cues with domestic policy uncertainty.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W14</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency and Bonds:</strong> The Indian rupee remained nearly flat against the US dollar, while bond yields traded steadily as market participants awaited the central bank&#x27;s interest rate guidance.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W19</a></span></li>
